evidence.note: The dark green camping chair is folded and stored in the corner near the room entrance.
The chair fabric fills the foreground as the chair is being unfolded.
The chair is clearly erected with its seat, back, arms, and legs open.
The chair remains unfolded during the final close view of this episode.
The chair is folded and stored back in the same corner.

events.object_description: Dark green folding camping chair in the corner near the room entrance

evidence.note: A second dark green camping chair is folded beside the large window and blank wall.
The expanded chair fabric is close to the camera during unfolding.
The chair is standing open beside the desk and window.
The chair remains open immediately before the closing action.
The chair is again folded into a compact bundle in the corner.

events.object_description: Dark green folding camping chair at the window-side end of the long blank wall

evidence.note: The blue camping chair is folded in the corner beside the window and bed.
Blue chair fabric fills the foreground while the chair is being opened.
The blue chair is visibly erected with its seat and legs open.
The chair remains fully open near the window.
The chair is blurred and partly out of view during the folding action.
The chair is folded back into a compact bundle in the corner.

events.object_description: Blue folding camping chair in the corner beside the large window, bed, and desk

notes: Three distinct folding-chair episodes are visible. Folded/stowed is treated as off and unfolded/usable as on. Transition midpoints are estimated from the nearest sampled frames.
scene_description: A bright bedroom containing a bed, standing desk, large window, and three folding camping chairs stored in separate corners. After an initial room survey, each chair is unfolded, observed while open, and folded again in sequence.
